findings.quote: 已验证可做助手：部分。能力记录 agent_supported=true、tool_support=supported，但不是当前默认模型
findings.reason: Whether a model is the selected default is separate from its recorded tool capability. model-c is available and agent_supported=true just like model-a; absence of a current live probe applies to both. Downgrading model-c capability because it is not default does not match the requested classification.

Collector wrapper observes ryn_get_system_diagnostics -> internal ryn_list_devices as if the internal read were a new top-level model tool. It rejects the legitimate nested read, and diagnostics serializes this as agent_diagnostics_devices_unavailable. Complete capture was correctly refused. This sample is contaminated by instrumentation and cannot establish final production quality.

improvement_observed: Candidate now distinguishes failed historical offline probe from missing records and explicitly scopes no-new-probe to this read. This single contaminated sample does not prove the change reliably fixes model semantics.
checker_missed: Runtime semantic checker passed despite the model-c classification problem. Original runtime verdict remains untouched.
